figuren.name: Frau Abrechnung

auszuege: TOP LEFT slot1 FEMALE-READ PAYROLL ACCOUNTANT: broad low squashed ink puddle, little dusty rose hair scarf on a soft goo curl, round brass pince-nez low below exhausted lids, small cream collar.

Cradles a fat mechanical adding machine with large round ivory keys; a thick blank paper receipt ribbon spills out and winds once loosely around her massive goo wrist, she attempts to wind it back with a pencil.

figuren.prompt_auszug: TOP LEFT slot1 FEMALE-READ PAYROLL ACCOUNTANT: broad low squashed ink puddle, little dusty rose hair scarf on a soft goo curl, round brass pince-nez low below exhausted lids, small cream collar. One eye desperately focused downward, other drifting, mouth a deep FLAT droop with one lower tooth. Cradles a fat mechanical adding machine with large round ivory keys; a thick blank paper receipt ribbon spills out and winds once loosely around her massive goo wrist, she attempts to wind it back with a pencil. Clear simple paper/hand relationship, familiar payroll grind made grotesquely tactile, no writing or detached clutter.
